# refactor deleted the regression suites protecting JC-005 and JC-006 and
# reintroduced both defects with nothing failing -- deleting a test never fails
# scripts/qa/check-protected-tests.sh fails CI if a listed file disappears or is
# Removing a line is a DELIBERATE, REVIEWABLE act. Do it only when the defect it
# guards is closed by design (the state is unrepresentable), never to make a
# build green. Migrating a file? Update the path here in the same commit.

column3: JC-005 assist/escalation bypass, JC-006 deactivated-actor internal notes
G-07 phone privacy enforced structurally
BR-1 matrix + current-state tripwires
BR-1 DB backstop, append-only logs, JC-010
RT-002/003/004 inverted guards: participant-set authorization, on_behalf_mode attribution
RT-005/007/008 inverted guards: signing secret, attachment validation, SYSTEM-message forgery
RT-024/025 BR-1 structural backstop, proven against the database with the application bypassed
RT-023 fresh-database acceptance: every table, FK, trigger and index a running system needs
RT-001 closed on BOTH halves: no source reads x-actor-id or handshake.auth.actorId, the gateway authenticates through the shared verifier, and each identity has exactly one writer
PD-2 a parent may join a Student Group call but never start one; BR-1/C-4 still take precedence
RT-001/NF-08 closed: a forged x-actor-id, body or query actorId cannot influence identity; cross-principal, cross-family and cross-organization impersonation refused
RT-001 token forgery: alg confusion, alg=none, unknown kid, foreign issuer/audience, expiry and tampering are each refused
Session revocation is immediate (logout, manager revoke, deactivation) and a replayed refresh token revokes every session on the account

Login rate limiting (IDENTITY-MODEL 4, API-CONTRACT 3.1): password spraying across many accounts is caught by the source budget, which account lockout cannot see; the limiter fails closed and cannot be reset by a success

Authentication audit trail (IDENTITY-MODEL 6): every login, refresh, logout and revocation is recorded in the same transaction as the state change, and refresh-reuse detection cannot revoke sessions without persisting why

column1: # Notification platform contract (engineering milestone, 2026-09). These are no
# longer "the tests for a feature" -- they are the platform's behavioural
# contract, and every one of them guards a defect that was real and shipped or
# a guarantee that is easy to lose in a refactor. Floors are set a little below
# the current count so ordinary edits are not blocked, and deleting a file

column3: Frozen content across a second schedule change; five-stage deduplication with the literal key per producer; quiet hours; grouping; retention; cross-device read publish
Worker crash mid-dispatch; delivery abandoned between provider success and acknowledgement (at-least-once, proven); ring-timeout races; provider outages; relay outage retried; offline recovery
A notification is not an authorization token: every push-payload id re-authorized. Guards the learner-id hole that exposed another family's student group
Every link shape against every target state: deleted, expired, withdrawn (410, not 404), unauthorized, revoked mid-flight
The preference is read at DELIVERY, not when queued; non-optional categories refused by service and trigger; essential types bypass a muted category
Duplicate publish and concurrent fan-out; audience security; priority escalation refused by service and trigger; targeting never reaches a parent
Every notification names its child and carries its id; nothing crosses a family
Socket handshake: no credential from the query string, client actorId ignored, room authorization, reconnect re-authorized
Every type has a category, priority, template and deep link; every optional category has at least one type a parent can actually mute
The tap that reaches the router, from running, terminated and signed-out. Guards the GoRouter-from-context defect that broke every notification tap
Read state converges across a parent's devices, both directions, no restart
The badge advances with no notification screen mounted, from every destination in the shell
App states A/B/E; offline recovery; a read attempted offline rolls back rather than lying
Token lifecycle, tap in all three app states, and idempotent consumption of a duplicate physical push
One shared transport; the client replays its rooms after a reconnect; the event contract mirrors the server's

column1: # Class session + attendance foundation (2026-09). Core is authoritative for
# both; these guard the properties that make Chat a faithful projection rather
# than a second opinion, and the authorization that keeps one family's classes

column3: Idempotent Core ingestion, source-time ordering, cancellation retains history, no orphan attendance, unmappable outcome refused not coerced, projection and event commit atomically

class_missed notifies once through the existing engine and class_attended notifies nobody; occurrence-keyed reminders; the schedule producer's crash window stays closed and a stale replay cannot resurrect obsolete reminders
No client session may assert a Core-authoritative class or attendance fact; reads never cross a family; a learner or session id is not authorization

column1: # Core → Chat webhook transport (2026-09). The only door into Jawwid Chat an
# unauthenticated caller can knock on, and everything behind it is
# Core-authoritative fact no client session may assert.

column3: HMAC over raw bytes, exact sha256= lowercase format, constant-time compare, replay window, key rotation, fail-closed when unconfigured, 1 MiB ceiling, secret never in a rejection

Envelope validation and allowlist; occurred_at preserved envelope→ledger→projection; backfill accepted but cannot regress newer state; recorded-but-failed is retryable not duplicate; refusals audited without credentials; clients cannot reach the ledger

Core identity is opaque text, never uuid: a real MongoDB ObjectId reaches a notification through the whole boundary; no core_*_id column or ingest cast may return to uuid; Chat-owned keys stay uuid; the blank-id fail-closed the uuid type gave for free is rebuilt
